facts.text: I want to organize my contacts from recent conversations with people from different backgrounds and industries.
I want a list or a spreadsheet to keep track of names, professions, and topics discussed with each person.
I want to categorize my contacts by industry or profession.
I want to add a column to track the location where I met each person.
I want the location column to include examples like a conference center, coffee shop, or street festival.
I want to add a column to track the method of communication used to follow up with each person.
I want the communication method column to include examples like email, phone call, or in-person meeting.
I want to add a column to track the outcome or result of each follow-up conversation.
I want the outcome column to include examples like whether it led to a new opportunity, a meeting, or no further action.
I want to add a column to track the next step or action item for each contact.
I want to use the next step column to stay on top of my follow-up tasks.

keyphrases: new opportunity meeting no further action
